# Jia Zhao

> Assistant Professor, Department of Mathematics, The University of Alabama. Modeling, analysis, and simulation of complex fluids and living systems.

Research website. One page per paper with the abstract, BibTeX, DOI, arXiv and code links, and (where present) an author-written summary.
Full list with abstracts: https://zhaojia.net/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Home](https://zhaojia.net/): appointments, education, research interests, contact
- [Research](https://zhaojia.net/research): research themes, grants, representative papers
- [Publications](https://zhaojia.net/publications): every released paper, by year
- [Software](https://zhaojia.net/software): the C2FD GPU solver family
- [People](https://zhaojia.net/people) · [Teaching](https://zhaojia.net/teaching)
